panels.detailed_description: Seven colour photographs arranged in three columns (two on the left, three in the middle, two on the right) on a white background, with the letter A at the upper left. The left and right columns show oblique close views of posterior teeth against red gingiva, some crowns with brown and opaque white surfaces and broken-down outlines. The middle column shows anterior views of the upper and lower front teeth with parted lips; the front teeth appear short with yellow-brown and opaque white surfaces and irregular edges. Lilac/lavender gloved fingers or instruments are visible in several photographs; no face, eyes or name is visible, only lips, gingiva and teeth.
